what: seed 46 accuracy vs the (uncontrolled) bridge noise offset entering training. Config identical across all; only the RNG offset differs.
headline: seed 46 accuracy ranges 0.200-1.000 under identical config, decided by an uncontrolled noise offset; an incidental read-only pre-train eval() flips it 1.0->0.2 (delta 0.800) while barely moving the robust seed 42 (delta 0.017). The 6-seed '5/6' reports the runner's pathological-offset value, not a robust per-seed property.
